component.name: Bolzplatz 2006
component.summary: Slam Soccer 2006 is a funny football game in 3D-comic-style

description.p: Bolzplatz 2006 / Slam Soccer 2006 is a funny football game in 3D-comic-style. The Bolzplatz 2006 game-engine is Open Source. The Bolzplatz 2006 data-files however are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 2.5 License and are not included in Fedora because of the no commercial use clause.
This package installs the engine and an applications menu entry for playing Bolzplatz 2006. The first time you click this menu entry, it will offer to download and install the datafiles for you.
